usedFor: Ecwid holds store customers and orders, HubSpot holds contacts and deals, and “New Customer Created” feeds “Create or Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Customer Created” in Ecwid, then “Create or Update Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: It creates the contact, or updates the one with the same email, so repeat shoppers stay one record.

watchOut: “Unfinished Order Updated” fires on each update, so “Create Deal” in HubSpot can add several deals per order.
